reason: This is a planner-core semantic expansion, not a local fix: it generalizes an index concept and touches plan selection (`find_best_task.go`), cost model (`plan_cost_ver2.go`), physical plan definitions/cloning, and plan serialization (`plan_to_pb.go`). Changes across these central optimizer paths can hide high-severity regressions in index selection, costing, EXPLAIN/visibility, and pushdown/runtime plan encoding, so it is worth a dedicated deep review.
